old_config.name: First geometry-only student feasibility pilot; not Ours final training
old_config.model: GeometryResidualUNet, 4 inputs, widths32/64/128, two downsamples, zero-initialized single residual head, 471841 parameters
old_config.augmentation: same uniform native crop and horizontal flip schedule in all3 variants; no resize, color augmentation or depth renormalization
old_config.base_frame_schedule: 80 independent seeded permutations of100 training frames;8000 exposures per variant, same ordered frame/crop/flip tuples; four source families only
old_config.joint_schedule: exactly2 natural and2 perturbed branch inputs per batch, shuffled with independent branch seed; same4000/4000 exposures; perturb source branch already contains20% no-op and crop may miss perturbation
old_config.precision: BF16 autocast forward, float32 residual addition/loss/parameters; no gradient scaling
old_config.geometry_loss: mean over valid batch pixels abs(preclamp_prediction-fixed_reference)
old_config.keep_loss: mean_S relu(abs(preclamp_prediction-actual_input)-epsilon); S from frozen data, excludes perturb footprint in perturbed branch; empty S yields0
old_config.evaluation: full native1024x436 frames, no test-time augmentation/re-alignment; both natural and fixed perturb branches on dev; train and dev at step0 and2000; record preclamp and clipped geometry MAE, fixed regions and unsupported-domain changes
old_config.primary_summary: unperturbed dev input, per-source valid-pixel MAE then equal weight over two dev sources; only final2000-step model is the fixed endpoint
old_config.checkpoint_selection: none; final only, intermediate evaluation is descriptive learning curve and does not change any run
old_config.abort: stop on nonfinite loss/gradient or implementation mismatch; preserve partial run, no automatic hyperparameter retry
old_config.scope: 150 existing frames only,100 train/50 dev; no VDA, ATB or teacher inference; no DAVIS access; no claim of convergence/generalization/Bokeh improvement from this small single-seed pilot

new_config.name: Follow-up single-factor interval preservation pilot
new_config.model: GeometryResidualUNet, 4 inputs, widths32/64/128, two downsamples, zero-initialized single residual head, 471841 parameters
new_config.augmentation: same uniform native crop and horizontal flip schedule in all3 variants; no resize, color augmentation or depth renormalization
new_config.base_frame_schedule: 80 independent seeded permutations of100 training frames;8000 exposures per variant, same ordered frame/crop/flip tuples; four source families only
new_config.joint_schedule: exactly2 natural and2 perturbed branch inputs per batch, shuffled with independent branch seed; same4000/4000 exposures; perturb source branch already contains20% no-op and crop may miss perturbation
new_config.precision: BF16 autocast forward, float32 residual addition/loss/parameters; no gradient scaling
new_config.geometry_loss: mean over valid batch pixels abs(preclamp_prediction-fixed_reference)
new_config.keep_loss: mean_S [relu(min(actual_input,reference)-preclamp_prediction)+relu(preclamp_prediction-max(actual_input,reference))]; same S and weight0.1 as v1; reference used in training loss only
new_config.evaluation: full native1024x436 frames, no test-time augmentation/re-alignment; both natural and fixed perturb branches on dev; train and dev at step0 and2000; record preclamp and clipped geometry MAE, fixed regions and unsupported-domain changes
new_config.primary_summary: unperturbed dev input, per-source valid-pixel MAE then equal weight over two dev sources; only final2000-step model is the fixed endpoint
new_config.checkpoint_selection: none; final only, intermediate evaluation is descriptive learning curve and does not change any run
new_config.abort: stop on nonfinite loss/gradient or implementation mismatch; preserve partial run, no automatic hyperparameter retry
new_config.scope: Follow-up informed by v1 dev results; same pilot dev is development data, not independent confirmation. No extra data, ATB, VDA, teacher or DAVIS inference; fixed final2000, no hyperparameter retry.
new_config.single_factor: keep-loss zero-penalty interval only; all model/data/seed/optimizer/steps/batch/crop/evaluation settings identical
new_config.acceptance: point estimates, not significance: compare near-reference MAE per dev source and equal-source mean with v1 and unchanged input; retain global MAE and boundary/unsupported effects. Full success requires near-reference and global MAE no worse than unchanged input on both dev sources; lower harm than v1 alone is partial.
